sectionSubtitle: Complete archive of full-stack web applications, operational dashboards, and payment-integrated platforms.

items.title: SPMS Lapas Empat Lawang
items.client: Lembaga Pemasyarakatan Kelas IIB Empat Lawang
items.summary: Laravel/MySQL operational web application supporting QR-based roll calls, location-assisted security checks, housing records, approvals, and reports.
deliverables: Developed and deployed a Laravel/MySQL operational web application supporting QR-based roll calls, location-assisted security checks, housing records, approvals, and reports.
Developed responsive desktop/mobile interfaces for officers and administrators, connecting QR and GPS-assisted workflows to application data.
Configured and maintained production hosting, domain, HTTPS, MySQL, SMTP, and scheduled jobs.

items.title: Fotodarikamu Event Camera Platform
items.summary: Event-based digital camera platform with Next.js, React, TypeScript, MySQL/MariaDB, QR guest camera flows, and Midtrans/DOKU QRIS webhooks.
deliverables: Developing an event-based digital camera platform with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and MySQL/MariaDB.
Built user-facing event and QR-code guest camera flows plus an administration dashboard for account and event management.
Integrated QRIS payment flows through Midtrans/DOKU and transaction-status webhooks.

items.title: Kantong Jamu Production & Inventory
items.summary: Production and inventory management application integrating production records, stock tracking, Bill of Materials, QC approval, and payroll.
deliverables: Built a Laravel/MySQL production and inventory management application integrating production records, stock tracking, Bill of Materials, and distribution.
Developed operational business logic for QC approval and activity-based payroll calculations; tested and refined application features.
